about: The offertorium of the formulary “Dedication of the Archbasilica of the Most Holy Savior” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord God, in the simplicity of my heart I have joyfully offered all these things; and I have seen with great joy Your people which are here present: O God of Israel, keep this will, alleluia.

ex.w007: The adjective describes the speaker, the unexpressed subject of “óbtuli” (w008): I have offered all these things gladly.
